headline: Volvo’s plug-in hybrid XC60 and XC90 can really go the distance
summary: Volvo's new XC60 and XC90 PHEVs offer significantly extended battery-only range. The updated models aim to push the limits of plug-in hybrid capabilities. Volvo is challenging average PHEV performance in the booming hybrid market.

headline: Valve is still figuring out ‘how and when’ to do Steam Deck 2
summary: Valve has launched its 2026 hardware lineup, but a Steam Deck 2 is not yet confirmed. The company is deliberating on the 'how and when' for a next-gen handheld. Designer Pierre-Loup suggests development is still in early stages.

headline: Is Big Tech’s AI slowdown a safety pact or a cartel?
summary: Top AI leaders agreed to slow AI development, citing a need to 'pace the frontier.' Critics question if this is a safety measure or a move towards market control. The pact involves major figures like Sam Altman, Demis Hassabis, and Elon Musk.

headline: Apple Home’s new security camera features cost as much as $60 a month
summary: Apple Home gains new AI-powered video summary features with iOS 27 and tvOS 27. These Apple Intelligence features are part of HomeKit Secure Video. Accessing these advanced security camera functions could cost up to $60 monthly.

headline: Marvel's Wolverine Actor Liam McIntyre Isn't Fazed by Players' Brutal Comments About the Game
summary: Liam McIntyre, actor for Marvel's Wolverine, is unfazed by player criticism. He acknowledges fan comments regarding Insomniac's new superhero game. McIntyre remains confident despite brutal feedback from the gaming community.

headline: 2026 Emmy Award Winners: The Full List
summary: The complete list of 2026 Emmy Award winners has been released. Discover who took home the top honors this year. Get all the details on the prestigious TV ceremony.

headline: Save $10 Off the LEGO Nintendo Game Boy Building Set With Walmart's Hidden Coupon Code
summary: Walmart is offering a hidden coupon code for $10 off the LEGO Nintendo Game Boy set. This building set is a must-have for LEGO enthusiasts and Nintendo fans. Grab this deal to own a unique piece of gaming nostalgia.

headline: Wardogs Players Are Avoiding One of the Game's Factions Because It Has a Stigma of Attracting the Stupidest Players
summary: Wardogs players are actively shunning the game's Lonestar faction. This faction is rumored to attract less skilled players, leading to frequent losses. The stigma is causing players to avoid it for competitive reasons.

headline: State pension likely to rise by £488 a year in April
summary: The UK state pension is projected to increase by £488 annually starting in April. This rise is attributed to the triple lock policy, which guarantees significant increases. The policy faces scrutiny due to rising pensioner numbers and increasing costs.

headline: Lucy Letby public inquiry findings set to be published
summary: The findings of the Thirlwall Inquiry into killer nurse Lucy Letby are due for release. The inquiry investigated how concerns about Letby were handled by authorities. It also explored if earlier intervention could have saved babies' lives.

headline: Trump says AI safety fears a 'hoax' as he rejects calls for greater safeguards
summary: Former President Trump dismissed AI safety concerns as a 'hoax,' rejecting calls for increased safeguards. His comments come after an AI co-founder suggested a mandatory 'kill switch.' Trump's stance contrasts with growing industry and expert warnings on AI risks.

headline: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys makes Emmy Awards history with double win
summary: Welsh actor Matthew Rhys achieved a historic double win at the Emmy Awards. He became the first person to win two lead acting prizes in a single night. Rhys's unprecedented success marks a significant moment at the prestigious TV ceremony.
